High Court Orders Inquiry into Caste Discrimination at RPNLU

The Allahabad High Court has ordered an inquiry into allegations of caste-based discrimination at Ram Manohar Lohiya National Law University (RPNLU). Separately, the Supreme Court has sought a report from the Allahabad High Court concerning allegations against the trial judge in the Lakhimpur Kheri violence case.
